Paste a code someone sent you. It holds a note\'s words, never its files, and is not encrypted: anyone with the code can read it.
Updating replaces what is on this device; you can undo it with “↩ Restore previous”. Adding leaves both, so you can compare them and delete one.

resources.string: Your notes are kept on this phone, in the app\'s own storage, where no other app can read them. Uninstalling the app removes them too, so Settings → Backup is the way to keep a copy, or to move them.
